title: the Glass Steppe Rising Anew
author: Ada Delacroix
blurb: Rosalind Halloran, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
